new.title: Successive constant output differences give exact fiber multiplicities on translation cosets of any binary vector map
new.statement:
∀ (g t : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin g → F
  let Y := Fin t → F
  ∀ f : X → Y,
    let dirs := fun H : Submodule F Y =>
      {v : X | ∀ x : X, (f (x+v) - f x) - (f v - f 0) ∈ H}
    let grow := fun prior : Submodule F Y =>
      prior ⊔ Submodule.span F ((fun value : X => f value - f 0) '' dirs prior)
    let H := fun j : ℕ => (grow^[j]) (⊥ : Submodule F Y)
    H (t+1) = H t ∧
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : X) (y : Y),
      let num := Nat.card {v : X // v ∈ dirs (H j) ∧ f (x+v) = y}
      (y - f x ∈ H (j+1) → num * Nat.card ↥(H (j+1)) = Nat.card ↥(dirs (H j))) ∧
      (y - f x ∉ H (j+1) → num = 0)
new.unlocks: Determines the exact multiplicity represented by each surviving quotient state when shifts of the output are exposed successively.
new.context: The difference along a sum of two directions telescopes. Directions with constant difference modulo H therefore form a subspace and the induced shifts give a linear map into the output quotient. Its image is the enlarged H modulo H. Split each current input coset into previous input cosets. By induction each previous coset covers a full H-coset uniformly. The induced linear map sends equal numbers of these pieces to every new output residue. Multiply the two multiplicities. A strict output enlargement raises dimension, and equality is permanent.

new.title: A fan-in-two circuit recovers all constant translation differences of degree-bounded binary vector maps from low-weight samples
new.statement:
∀ (n t d : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin n → F
  let Y := Fin t → F
  let low := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin n) => S.card ≤ d)
  ∀ enumerate : Fin low.card ≃ ↥low,
    let inputs := 1+t*low.card
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
      (proj : Fin n → Fin n → Fin (inputs+C.size))
      (offset : Fin t → Fin n → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
      C.size ≤ 2^20 * (n+t+2)^9 * low.card ∧
      ∀ f : X → Y,
        (∀ j : Fin t, ∃ c : Finset (Fin n) → F, ∀ x : X,
          f x j = ∑ S ∈ low, c S * ∏ i ∈ S, x i) →
        let bits := [false] ++ (List.ofFn (fun component : Fin t =>
          List.ofFn (fun a : Fin low.card =>
            decide (f (fun i => if i ∈ (enumerate a).val then 1 else 0) component ≠ 0)))).flatten
        let bit := fun w : Fin (inputs+C.size) => if (C.wires bits).getD w.val false then (1:F) else 0
        let P := fun (v : X) (row : Fin n) => ∑ i : Fin n, bit (proj row i) * v i
        let L := fun (direction : X) (coord : Fin t) => ∑ i : Fin n, bit (offset coord i) * direction i
        (∀ z : X, P (P z) = P z) ∧ ∀ (v : X) (a : Y),
          (∀ x : X, f (x+v) = f x + a) ↔ P v = v ∧ L v = a
new.unlocks: Computes the full space and values of constant differences on each output quotient using a sample table of bounded weight.
new.context: Use a subset transform on sets of size at most d to recover square-free coefficients. On directions whose differences have degree at most j, their degree-j coefficients are linear in the direction: translation preserves the highest homogeneous part and differences telescope. Stack those coefficients on a current basis and take their common kernel, descending to degree zero. To shift by a live vector, for each toggled coordinate add a monomial coefficient to that of the set with the coordinate removed. Complete the final basis to output the projection and constant shifts.

new.title: Output quotients give a fan-in-two circuit counting distinct affine keys matching degree-bounded cyclic probes across rounds
new.statement:
∀ (k m t r g h d : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), h ≤ g → g ≤ min k m →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let Y := Fin t → F
  let low := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin g) => S.card ≤ d)
  let W := Fin k → ZMod 2
  let ix := fun index : ℕ => (⟨index%k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let shift := fun (inputPos : Fin k) (s : ℕ) => ix (inputPos.val+k-s%k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (word : W) (pos : Fin k) => word (shift pos s)
  ∀ (site : Fin t → Fin k)
    (column : Fin t → Bool) (time : Fin t → Fin (r+1)),
    let delay := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 2 else 1
    let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
    let feed := fun (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) => if b then 3*(i+1)+1 else 2*i
    let inputs := (m+3+2*r)*k+t
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (inputs+C.size))
        (out : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
      C.size ≤ 2^44 * (k+m+t+r+3)^14 * (low.card + 2^(g-h)) ∧
      ∀ (base : W) (gen : Fin m → W) (u v : W) (cr cc : Fin r → W) (target : Y),
        let D := Submodule.span F (Set.range gen)
        let raw := fun a : Fin m → F => base + ∑ i : Fin m, a i • gen i
        let run := fun (b : Bool) (w : W) (n : ℕ) =>
          ((List.finRange r).take n).foldl (fun z tick =>
            let mix := fun midPos : Fin k =>
              z midPos + z (ix (midPos.val+delay b)) + z (shift midPos (delay b))
            fun j : Fin k =>
              mix j + (1+mix (ix (j.val+1)))*mix (ix (j.val+2)) +
              rot (feed b tick.val) w j + (if b then cc tick else cr tick) j)
            (rot (start b) w + (if b then v else u))
        let pack := fun inputWord : W => List.ofFn (fun bit : Fin k => decide (inputWord bit ≠ 0))
        let bits := pack base ++ (List.ofFn (fun gi => pack (gen gi))).flatten ++
          pack u ++ pack v ++ (List.ofFn (fun ri => pack (cr ri))).flatten ++
          (List.ofFn (fun ci => pack (cc ci))).flatten ++ List.ofFn (fun obsIdx => decide (target obsIdx ≠ 0))
        let probe := fun (word : W) (obsIdx : Fin t) =>
          run (column obsIdx) word (time obsIdx).val (site obsIdx)
        let eval := fun x : D => probe (base+x.val)
        let dirs := fun H : Submodule F Y =>
          {v' : D | ∀ x : D, (eval (x+v') - eval x) - (eval v' - eval 0) ∈ H}
        let grow := fun prior : Submodule F Y =>
          prior ⊔ Submodule.span F ((fun stepVec : D => eval stepVec - eval 0) '' dirs prior)
        let finalSpace := (grow^[t]) (⊥ : Submodule F Y)
        let wire := fun address : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD address.val false
        Module.finrank F D = g →
        (∀ probeIdx : Fin t, ∃ c : Finset (Fin m) → F, ∀ a : Fin m → F,
          probe (raw a) probeIdx =
            ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin m) => T.card ≤ d), c S * ∏ i ∈ S, a i) →
        (wire flag = true ↔ 2^h ≤ Nat.card ↥(dirs finalSpace)) ∧
        (wire flag = true →
          let count := Nat.card {x : D // eval x = target}
          ∀ o : Fin (k+1), wire (out o) = count.testBit o.val)
new.unlocks: Replaces enumeration of passing raw keys by low-weight samples and one representative per residual coset, with arbitrary cyclic observation times.
new.context: Choose independent raw generators and evaluate the physical probes on one low-weight sample table. Project the samples modulo each current output space. The constant-difference extractor returns the next input directions. Evaluate original output shifts on a basis and enlarge the output space. Repeat t times and extract once at the fixed space. When a directions remain, enumerate 2^(g-a) representatives. Each matching output residue contributes 2^(a-dim H) by the coset fiber lemma. Disable unused slots and sum in k+1 bits. The sampling and enumeration costs add.

new.title: Exact hit rate for short local prediction lists after adaptive parity questions on guarded cyclic windows
new.statement:
∀ (k : Nat), 0 < k → ∀ constant : Nat → Fin (2 ^ k),
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc cell =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit cell)
        (!(word.testBit ((cell + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((cell + 2) % k))).toNat <<< cell)) 0
  let state := fun (row rounds key : Nat) =>
    (List.range rounds).foldl (fun prev tick =>
      step (prev ^^^ rot 1 prev ^^^ rot (k - 1) prev) ^^^ rot (2 * tick) key ^^^
        (constant (tick + 1)).val) (rot 1 key ^^^ row)
  let injected := fun (round key pos : Nat) =>
    xor ((rot (2 * (round - 1)) key).testBit (pos % k))
      ((constant round).val.testBit (pos % k))
  let bit := fun (row round key pos : Nat) => (state row round key).testBit (pos % k)
  ∀ (m : Nat) (starts : Fin m → Nat),
  Function.Injective (fun z : Fin m × Fin 12 => (starts z.1+z.2.val)%k) →
  let good := fun (row ref : Fin (2^k)) (p : Nat) =>
    let old := fun (j : Nat) => bit row.val 0 ref.val (p+j)
    let first := fun (j : Nat) => bit row.val 1 ref.val (p+j)
    let τ := xor (xor (old 6) (old 7)) (old 8)
    let α := xor (xor (xor (old 5) (old 6)) (old 7)) (injected 1 ref.val (p+6))
    let β := xor τ (injected 1 ref.val (p+7))
    τ = false ∧ xor (xor (first 3) (first 4)) (first 5) = true ∧
      xor (first 4) (first 5) = !α ∧ first 4 = β
  ∀ (row ref : Fin (2^k)), (∀ i, good row ref (starts i)) →
  ∀ pin : Finset (Fin k),
  (∀ i (j : Fin 9), ∃ z ∈ pin, z.val = (starts i+j.val)%k) →
  (∀ i (j : Fin 3), ∀ z ∈ pin, z.val ≠ (starts i+9+j.val)%k) →
  let K := Fin (2^k)
  let bitOf := fun (q : K) (i : Fin k) => q.val.testBit i.val
  let par := fun (n : Nat) => n % 2 == 1
  let fiber := (Finset.univ : Finset K).filter (fun keyWord =>
    ∀ z ∈ pin, bit row.val 0 keyWord.val z.val = bit row.val 0 ref.val z.val)
  let run := fun (steps : Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → K → Bool) (x : K) =>
    (List.range steps).foldl (fun past levelId => past + ((ask levelId past x).toNat <<< levelId)) 0
  let out := fun (input : K) (i : Fin m) => bit row.val 2 input.val (starts i+5)
  let Symbol := Fin 3 → Bool
  let triple := fun (raw : K) (idx : Fin m) (v : Fin 3) =>
    bit row.val 0 raw.val (starts idx+9+v.val)
  let low := fun (f : Symbol → Bool) => ∃ monomials : Finset (Finset (Fin 3)),
    (∀ mon ∈ monomials, mon.card ≤ 2) ∧ ∀ symbol,
      f symbol = par ((monomials.filter (fun mon => ∀ coord ∈ mon, symbol coord = true)).card)
  ∀ (d s L : Nat), 2^s*L ≤ 8 →
    let res := m-d
    let Kslots := 2^s*L
    let missed := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin res → Fin 8)).filter (fun residualWord =>
      ∀ a : Fin Kslots, ∃ j, (residualWord j).val = a.val)).card
    let affine := fun (ask : Nat → Nat → K → Bool) =>
      ∀ u : Fin d, ∀ path, ∃ (mask : Finset (Fin k)) (c : Bool), ∀ raw,
        ask u.val path raw = xor c (par ((mask.filter (fun b => bitOf raw b = true)).card))
    let listOK := fun (leaf : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → Symbol → Bool) =>
      ∀ history label i, low (leaf history label i)
    let hit := fun (ask : Nat → Nat → K → Bool)
        (leaf : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → Symbol → Bool) =>
      (fiber.filter (fun sample => ∃ a, ∀ i,
        leaf (run (d+s) ask sample) a i (triple sample i) = out sample i)).card
    ∀ H : Nat,
      (∃ ask leaf, affine ask ∧ listOK leaf ∧ H ≤ hit ask leaf) ↔
        8^res * H ≤ fiber.card * (8^res - missed)
new.unlocks: Prices partial simultaneous recovery after adaptive affine questions and arbitrary final answer bits.
new.context: Fix the exterior and an attained affine prefix. A basis of the prefix equations has at most d pivot bits, so n whole nonpivot triples are jointly uniform. Each local quadratic misses a symbol. Pool the lists at up to 2^s continuations, project to these triples and use the sharp union count. For equality query one bit in each of min(d,m) triples and absorb their cubics. On the rest, use injective singleton-error menus. The s final bits select a successful group whenever one exists.

new.title: A short disjoint certificate for an input defeating all but t entries of a translated prediction list
new.statement:
∀ (q m h t : Nat), 0 < q →
  let A := Fin (m+h)
  let W := Fin m → Fin q
  ∀ label : Fin m → A → Fin q,
    let live := fun (x : W) =>
      ((Finset.univ : Finset A).filter (fun a => ∀ i, x i ≠ label i a)).card
    let cert := fun (w : W) (I : Finset (Fin m)) (bucket : Fin m → Finset A) =>
      I.card ≤ h-t ∧ (I.biUnion bucket).card = I.card + (h-t) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, 2 ≤ (bucket i).card ∧ ∀ a ∈ bucket i, label i a = w i) ∧
      ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → Disjoint (bucket i) (bucket j)
    (∀ x : W, live x ≤ t → ∃ I bucket, cert x I bucket) ∧
    ∀ (word : W) I bucket, cert word I bucket →
      ∃ y : W, (∀ j ∈ I, y j = word j) ∧ live y ≤ t
new.unlocks: Decides failure of a translated list by selecting disjoint groups in at most its excess number of coordinates.
new.context: Assign each killed label to one coordinate where it was struck. If g=max(h-t,0)>0, the sum of positive bucket sizes minus one per nonempty bucket is at least g. Keep buckets of size at least two until their excess first reaches g. Trim the final bucket to make the excess exactly g. At most g buckets were used. Conversely keep their symbols and inject as many remaining labels as needed into distinct unused coordinates, assigning each its own forbidden symbol. For g=0 the empty certificate suffices.

changed.title: Small success advantages for repeated cyclic count scans have different memory costs at prime and binary power moduli
changed.statement:
∀ (d n p k : Nat), 0 < d → 0 < p → 0 < k →
  let w := d+2
  let D := 2^w
  let M := 4^d
  let Q := 2^k
  2*(k*(2*w+(2^w-1))+w) ≤ n →
  let Row := Nat → Bool
  let total := fun (rows : Nat → Row) =>
    ((List.range (2^n)).filter (fun word => (List.range n).all (fun site =>
      let pat := (List.range (w+1)).foldl (fun (acc bit : Nat) =>
        acc ||| ((word.testBit ((site+bit)%n)).toNat <<< bit)) 0
      rows site pat))).length
  let run := fun (S : Nat) (start : Fin S)
      (step : Nat → Nat → Fin S → Row → Fin S) (table : Nat → Row) =>
    (List.range p).foldl (fun prev passId =>
      (List.range n).foldl (fun state siteId => step passId siteId state (table siteId)) prev) start
  let succeeds := fun (m S R a b : Nat) =>
    ∃ (init : Fin R → Fin S) (update : Fin R → Nat → Nat → Fin S → Row → Fin S)
      (output : Fin R → Fin S → Nat), ∀ input : Nat → Row,
        a*R ≤ b*((List.finRange R).filter (fun coin =>
          output coin (run S (init coin) (update coin) input) == (total input)%m)).length
  ((∀ j : Nat, j ≤ k →
      succeeds Q (2^(j*(D*((D+p-1)/p)+1))) (2^(k-j)) (2^j) Q ∧
      ∀ S R : Nat, 0 < R → succeeds Q S R (2^j) Q → 2^(j*M) ≤ 4*S^(2*p-1)) ∧
    ∀ prime S' R' : Nat, Nat.Prime prime → prime ≤ Q → 0 < R' →
      succeeds prime S' R' 2 prime → prime^M ≤ (prime-1)^2*S'^(2*p-1))
changed.unlocks: prices memory for beating uniform guessing in repeated cyclic counts at prime and power-of-two moduli
changed.context: Encode two k-bit endpoint matrices on tagged banks and guard two tag flips, padding the last reset by affine feedback. The cyclic count is their inner product. The 2p-1 state transfers partition the inputs for fixed random bits. Apply the divisor bound. At a prime only the trivial and primitive orders occur. For 2^k the orders below 2^j contribute at most 2^(j-1). The other terms decrease geometrically after removing the common transcript factor, since M>=4. For achievability batch seeds, compute the trace modulo 2^j and guess the remaining bits uniformly.

changed.title: Field rank of the matrix counting fixed points of products of two permutations
changed.statement:
∀ (K : Type) [Field K] (b d : ℕ),
  let q := b + 2
  let P := Equiv.Perm (Fin q)
  let fixed := fun (p r : P) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)).filter (fun i => r (p i) = i)).card
  let threshold := if ringChar K ∣ q then
      (q - 2) ^ 2 + (if ringChar K = 2 then 0 else 1)
    else (q - 1) ^ 2 + 1
  (∃ (A B : P → Fin d → K),
    ∀ p r, (fixed p r : K) = ∑ j : Fin d, A p j * B r j) ↔
    threshold ≤ d
changed.unlocks: determines the least factorization dimension of the permutation fixed-point count matrix over every field
changed.context: Let U be the zero-sum vectors and T the constants. Two permutations differing by swapping two images give an arbitrary outer product of coordinate differences. On E=U/(U intersect T), their images span End(E) since the dot product descends nondegenerately. All these differences act by zero on the trivial factors. One permutation supplies the independent common scalar. Trace of a product pairs the E blocks nondegenerately and adds one scalar product, or two if the characteristic divides q. Two vanish in characteristic two.

changed.title: Fixing a degree-two vertex v of a graph with no 4-cycle, where G - v and G - N[v] keep an edge, saves at least three gates at false or at least four at true
changed.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (v u w : Fin n) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E) → ((b, c) ∈ E ∨ (c, b) ∈ E) → ((c, d) ∈ E ∨ (d, c) ∈ E) → ((d, a) ∈ E ∨ (a, d) ∈ E) → False) → u ≠ w → ((v, u) ∈ E ∨ (u, v) ∈ E) → ((v, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, v) ∈ E) → (∀ z : Fin n, ((v, z) ∈ E ∨ (z, v) ∈ E) → z = u ∨ z = w) → (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ v ∧ e.2 ≠ v) → (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ v ∧ e.2 ≠ v ∧ e.1 ≠ u ∧ e.2 ≠ u ∧ e.1 ≠ w ∧ e.2 ≠ w) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => x e.1 && x e.2)) → (∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size + 3 ≤ C.size ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => Function.update x v false e.1 && Function.update x v false e.2)) ∨ (∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size + 4 ≤ C.size ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => Function.update x v true e.1 && Function.update x v true e.2))

changed.title: A row guard history on a shortened seed permits q additional column pivots for every successful prefix
changed.statement:
∀ (k r q ell : Nat), 0 < q → q+2 ≤ r → 7*r+q ≤ k → k-(k+1)/2+q ≤ 6*r →
  5 ≤ ell → ell ≤ r → 5*ell+q ≤ 5*r+2 →
  let h := (k+1)/2
  let z := k-h
  let u := 5*r-3
  let tries := ell-1
  let rot := fun (offset x : Nat) =>
    ((x <<< (offset%k)) ||| (x >>> (k-offset%k))) % 2^k
  let mix := fun (gap value : Nat) => value ^^^ rot gap value ^^^ rot (k-gap) value
  let chi := fun (word : Nat) => (List.range k).foldl (fun acc site =>
    acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit site)
      (!(word.testBit ((site+1)%k)) && word.testBit ((site+2)%k))).toNat <<< site)) 0
  let step := fun (constants : Nat → Fin (2^k)) (col : Bool) (raw prev t : Nat) =>
    chi (mix (if col then 2 else 1) prev) ^^^ rot (if col then 3*t+1 else 2*(t-1)) raw ^^^
      (constants (if col then r+t else t)).val
  let state := fun (c : Nat → Fin (2^k)) (side : Bool) (key name : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun v tick => step c side key v (tick+1))
      (rot (if side then 3 else 1) key ^^^ name)
  let start := k-(2*r-2)
  let a := min h (k-u)
  let g := z-u
  let project := fun (wordAt : Nat) => rot (k-(start%k)) wordAt % 2^(u-q)
  let weight := fun (code : Nat) => ((List.range tries).filter (fun jj => code.testBit jj)).length
  ∀ (sched : Nat → Fin (2^k)) (row col : Fin (2^k)),
    let history := fun (label : Nat) =>
      let ref := rot start label
      let init : Nat × Nat × Nat := (rot 1 ref ^^^ row.val, 0, 0)
      let final := (List.range ell).foldl (fun triple idx =>
        let time := idx+1
        let place := k-q+3*(r-time)+min (q-1) triple.2.2
        let bit := (mix 1 triple.1).testBit ((place+1)%k)
        let next := step sched false ref triple.1 time
        if time=4 then (next, triple.2.1, triple.2.2)
        else (next, 2*triple.2.1+bit.toNat, triple.2.2+bit.toNat)) init
      final.2.1
    (∀ hist : Fin (2^tries),
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2^(u-q)))).filter
        (fun tag => history tag.val = hist.val)).card = 2^(u-q-tries)) ∧
    (∀ (seedTag : Fin (2^(u-q))) (rowBits : Fin (2^a)) (colBits : Fin (2^(q+g))),
      q ≤ weight (history seedTag.val) →
      ∃! w : Fin (2^k), project w.val = seedTag.val ∧
        (state sched false w.val row.val >>> (k-a)) = rowBits.val ∧
        (state sched true w.val col.val >>> (6*r-q)) % 2^(q+g) = colBits.val)

changed.title: Fixed parity queries recover a paired-test graph exactly when witness differences admit a cover by classes without short odd zero sums
changed.statement:
∀ (n q rows cols pairs names messages : ℕ)
    (Y : Fin rows → Fin pairs → Bool → Fin names) (pass : Fin names → Bool)
    (col : Fin cols → Fin pairs → Bool → Bool) (pick : Fin rows → Fin pairs → Bool)
    (tag : Fin rows → Fin messages) (feature : Fin rows → Fin pairs → Fin n → ZMod 2),
  let V := Fin n → ZMod 2
  let edge := fun (r : Fin rows) (c : Fin cols) =>
    ∃ (z : Fin pairs) (p : Bool), pass (Y r z p) = true ∧ col c z p = true
  let seen := fun (r : Fin rows) (z : Fin pairs) => Y r z (pick r z)
  let direct := fun (r : Fin rows) (c : Fin cols) =>
    ∃ z, pass (seen r z) = true ∧ col c z (pick r z) = true
  let avail := fun (r : Fin rows) (c : Fin cols) (z : Fin pairs) =>
    col c z (!(pick r z)) = true
  let Need := {cell : Fin rows × Fin cols // edge cell.1 cell.2 ∧ ¬direct cell.1 cell.2}
  let conflict := fun (sel : Need → Fin pairs) (d : V) =>
    ∃ (t : Need) (r : Fin rows) (c : Fin cols) (z : Fin pairs),
      ¬edge r c ∧ avail r c z ∧ tag t.val.1 = tag r ∧
      seen t.val.1 (sel t) = seen r z ∧ feature t.val.1 (sel t) + feature r z = d
  (∃ (query : Fin q → (V →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2))
      (lookup : Fin messages → Fin names → (Fin q → ZMod 2) → Bool),
    ∀ (r : Fin rows) (c : Fin cols), edge r c ↔
      (direct r c ∨ ∃ z, avail r c z ∧
        lookup (tag r) (seen r z) (fun i => query i (feature r z)) = true)) ↔
  ∃ sel : Need → Fin pairs,
    (∀ t, avail t.val.1 t.val.2 (sel t)) ∧ ∃ parts : Fin q → Finset V,
      (∀ d, conflict sel d ↔ ∃ i, d ∈ parts i) ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin q) (s : Finset V), s ⊆ parts i → s.card ≤ n + 1 →
        s.card % 2 = 1 → (∑ v ∈ s, v) ≠ 0
changed.unlocks: Reduces the one-extra-parity question on the sixteen shift-12 columns to an affine span test, and gives an exact criterion when many positive columns or shared row messages must be served together.
changed.context: Choose an accepted mate per uncovered true cell. Every matching negative occurrence differs on some query. Put its difference in a class for a query taking value one. Conversely prescribe one on a basis taken from each class. A nonbasis vector with an even expansion gives an odd zero sum of size at most n+1. Extend the form linearly. Accept only the selected message, output and transcript triples. A negative match would give a class difference killed by every query. Details at f573a443dc, notes/seat-rlift-1/output-labels/parity-repair.md.

changed.title: Every attained polynomial-query prefix bounds the joint failure of all its reachable lists
changed.statement:
∀ (m r d : Nat),
  let V := Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let Symbol := Fin r → Bool
  let deg := fun (b : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ b) ∧ ∀ word,
      f word = (((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ v ∈ mon, word v = true)).card % 2) == 1)
  let run := fun (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (len : Nat) (x : W) =>
    (List.range len).foldl (fun h step => h + ((ask step h x).toNat <<< step)) 0
  ∀ (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (anchor : W) (j : Nat), j ≤ d →
    let pathCode := run ask j anchor
    let cell := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun sample => run ask j sample = pathCode)
    let leaves := cell.image (run ask d)
    ∀ B : Fin j → Nat, (∀ t, deg (B t) (ask t.val (run ask t.val anchor))) →
      ∃ U : Finset V, U.card ≤ ∑ t : Fin j, B t ∧
        ∀ (L : Nat) (bad : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → Symbol),
          let gone := U.image Prod.fst
          let outside := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun w =>
            ∀ h ∈ leaves, ∀ a, ∃ i, i ∉ gone ∧ (fun v => w (i,v)) = bad h a i)
          let errors := cell.filter (fun input => ∀ a, ∃ i,
            (fun v => input (i,v)) = bad (run ask d input) a i)
          outside.card ≤ 2^U.card * errors.card
changed.unlocks: Controls the joint failures of every reachable continuation through a set chosen before the lists.
changed.context: Multiply the answer literals of the fixed prefix. Induction on the recorded answers identifies this product with its indicator. Reduce modulo x^2=x, keeping the degree at most the sum of the path bounds. The anchor makes it one, so choose a maximal surviving monomial U. Apply the maximal-monomial bound to the concatenation of lists at all reached leaves below this prefix. On the cell, killing them all kills the list actually returned.
